verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents running a local Docker Compose instance "recommended for testing", which can serve as an isolated non-production deployment. It also documents offline experiments against fixed datasets, so prompt and code changes can be tested without touching live traffic. Prompt labels can manage deployments across environments. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated sandbox environment, test project, or test API keys that isolate test data from production. missing for 10: a documented first-class sandbox/test environment feature, explicit data isolation between test and production projects or environments, and independent hands-on corroboration.
